tools.name: find_brands
tools.description: Find food, beverage and pet brands, and see where to apply to each for a wholesale account. Filter by text, category path, country, availability or `submittable`. The text in `q` can match the name, other names or description of a brand. Search allows small spelling errors and returns at most the be

tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: Get the facts of one brand by its slug: its company, its categories, each relationship with its availability, and the sources. The result is the JSON twin at `/brands/{slug}.json`.

tools.name: get_relationship
tools.description: Get a brand's relationship: where to apply, each fact with its source quote, and whether Linty read the brand's terms. The facts include the form fields and the documents that the brand asks for. A fact has its quote in `source` only when LintyBot read it on the brand's page. Read `terms` before you

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Get one company by its slug, with the brands that it owns. The result is the JSON twin at `/companies/{slug}.json`.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the categories under a path, or the top-level categories, with counts of published brands. A category has a page when it has 10 published brands. tools.name: report_correction
tools.description: Report a wrong fact about a brand or one of its relationships. Write what is wrong and what is right, in 10 to 2,000 characters. A person at Linty reads each correction.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_brands" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
